description: Phase 1 — Core Loop, Cash Awareness, Decision Engine, Card Management, Onboarding, Monetization, Data & Privacy, Analytics

userStories.title: Add a credit card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to add a credit card with my statement day and credit limit, so that I can see my billing cycle status immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Card form accepts: bank name, credit limit, outstanding balance, statement day, due day offset (with sensible defaults)
After saving, card appears in card list with SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY badge calculated from entered data
Status is calculated and displayed without requiring an app reload or additional action

userStories.title: See SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to open the app and instantly see SAFE, CAUTION, or RISKY for each card, so that I know at a glance whether it's safe to swipe today.
acceptanceCriteria: Home screen renders all card statuses within 1 second of app open
Each card status is displayed with three simultaneous channels: color (emerald/amber/crimson) + icon (✓/⚠/✕) + text label (SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY)
Each status includes a one-line reason (e.g., '14 days to statement · 28% utilization')

userStories.title: Swipe Impact calculator
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter a proposed spend amount and see how it affects my next statement, so that I can decide whether to swipe or wait.
acceptanceCriteria: Amount input auto-opens numeric keyboard with quick-amount chips (₱500, ₱1K, ₱2K, ₱5K) visible without scrolling
Status badge, projected statement balance, available cash, and payoff plan update in real time as the amount is typed — no submit button required
Carried balance amount and estimated monthly interest cost are shown when full payoff is not possible given net available cash

userStories.title: Best card recommendation
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a 'best card to use today' recommendation, so that I don't have to compare cards manually before each purchase.
acceptanceCriteria: Home screen shows a single best-card recommendation as a prominent hero element with bank name and SAFE badge
Best card is determined by the multi-card scoring algorithm: score = utilization×100 + days penalty + status penalty + cash coverage penalty; lowest-scoring SAFE card wins
If no SAFE card exists, shows the lowest-scoring CAUTION card with an explicit warning label

userStories.title: Billing cycle timeline
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a visual timeline of my billing cycle, so that I know exactly how far I am from statement close and due date.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline strip shows: cycle start → today marker → statement close → due date with labeled date markers
Statement close marker changes color at ≤7 days (amber) and ≤2 days (crimson) to communicate urgency
Multi-card Gantt view shows all cards stacked vertically, sorted by urgency (closest statement close first), with color-coded bars by status

userStories.title: Update balance
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to update my outstanding balance quickly after checking my bank app, so that my status stays accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Update balance' action is accessible from the card detail screen and tappable from the staleness warning banner
Single numeric field accepts the new balance; saves immediately on confirm
Timestamp is updated to 'just now' and any active staleness warning is cleared after saving

userStories.title: Data freshness warning
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a warning when my balance data is stale, so that I don't trust a SAFE status based on outdated information.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card shows 'Balance updated X days ago' timestamp in secondary text at all times
At 5+ days since last update: amber ⚠️ inline warning appears on the card with a 'Tap to update' CTA
At 10+ days since last update: the SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status badge is replaced by a staleness indicator ('Data stale — update before trusting this status')

userStories.title: Set liquid cash on hand
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter how much liquid cash I have available, so that Falcly can calculate whether I can actually pay my bill.
acceptanceCriteria: Cash on hand field is accessible from profile/settings and prompted as an optional step during onboarding
Net available cash recalculates immediately whenever the cash on hand value is changed
Field shows timestamp 'Cash updated X days ago' and appears with a staleness nudge after 5+ days without update

userStories.title: Set monthly income and payday
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter my monthly income and the day it arrives, so that Falcly knows whether my paycheck lands before my card due date.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile settings accepts monthly income (number) and payday (day of month, 1–31)
income_before_due_date flag is computed correctly: true if payday ≤ card due date
Monthly income is added to net available cash only when payday precedes the card due date; excluded otherwise

userStories.title: Set committed monthly expenses
userStories.description: As Beth, I want to enter my total monthly committed expenses as a single number, so that Falcly deducts them from my available cash before projecting my payoff capacity.
acceptanceCriteria: Single numeric input for total committed monthly expenses (not itemized categories) in profile/settings
Amount is deducted from net available cash in all Swipe Impact and payoff calculations
Shown as a labeled line item in the Swipe Impact breakdown: 'Committed expenses: −₱X,XXX'

userStories.title: Net available cash display
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see my net available cash figure in the Swipe Impact screen, so that I understand exactly how much I can put toward my card bill this cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Net available cash is displayed in the Swipe Impact screen as a labeled line: 'Available to pay: ₱X,XXX'
Formula applied: liquid_cash + (income if payday ≤ due_date) − committed_expenses − auto_payments − subscriptions_this_cycle
Figure updates in real time when cash on hand, income, or committed expenses change

userStories.title: RISKY when cash below minimum payment
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show RISKY when my available cash can't cover the minimum payment, so that I'm warned before I get into a situation I can't handle.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is RISKY when net_available_cash < minimum_payment (max(outstanding × min_pct, min_floor))
Reason shown: 'You won't be able to make the minimum payment'
This condition takes priority over all other SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY conditions (first match wins)

userStories.title: RISKY when statement closes in 2 days
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show RISKY when my statement closes in 2 days or fewer, so that I don't accidentally add to a bill that's about to be finalized.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is RISKY when days_to_statement ≤ 2
Reason shown: 'Statement closes in {n} day(s) — charge will hit this bill'
Condition is evaluated even when no proposed swipe amount is entered

userStories.title: CAUTION when statement closes in 7 days
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show CAUTION when my statement closes within 7 days, so that I'm alerted to be careful even before the critical 2-day window.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is CAUTION when days_to_statement ≤ 7 (and not already RISKY from a higher-priority condition)
Reason shown: '{n} days to statement — charge lands on this bill'
Statement close marker on the cycle timeline turns amber color at ≤7 days

userStories.title: Projected statement balance formula
userStories.description: As Ria, I want the projected statement balance formula to include my pending transactions and committed installments, so that my status reflects what's actually hitting my next bill.
acceptanceCriteria: projected_statement_balance = outstanding_balance + pending_transactions + installments_monthly_amount + subscriptions_this_cycle + proposed_swipe
Annual fee is added to the projected balance in the cycle month it is due
Calculation is deterministic: same inputs always produce the same projected balance

userStories.title: Flexible horizon timeline
userStories.description: As Ria, I want the flexible horizon timeline to project future cycles based on known fixed events, so that I can see the impact of my installments over the coming months.
acceptanceCriteria: Future cycle projections are shown for as many cycles as fixed events (installments, subscriptions, annual fees) exist
Each projected cycle shows: opening balance, known committed items, and a SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY signal
Cycles beyond the last known fixed event show a signal only (On Track / At Risk / Unknown) — no fabricated numbers

userStories.title: Edit card details
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to edit a card's details after I've added it, so that I can correct mistakes or update settings like interest rate and due date offset.
acceptanceCriteria: All card fields (limit, statement day, due day offset, interest rate, min payment, annual fee) are editable from the card detail settings tab
Saving edits immediately recalculates and updates the card's SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status
Edit screen is accessible from the card detail screen with a clearly labeled 'Edit Card' action

userStories.title: Delete a card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to delete a card from Falcly, so that I can remove cards I've cancelled or no longer want to track.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete action is available in the card detail settings tab with a confirmation dialog before deletion
Deleting a card removes it from the card list and recalculates 'best card today' immediately
If the deleted card was a Pro-only card and the user is on Free, the remaining cards still function normally

userStories.title: 3-field onboarding
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to add my first card and get an immediate status result with just 3 fields, so that I see Falcly's value before being asked for more information.
acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding card entry requires only: statement day, credit limit, and outstanding balance — all other fields use defaults
After entering these 3 fields and tapping save, the user lands on their first SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY result screen
Additional enrichment fields (cash on hand, due day offset, interest rate) are prompted optionally after the first result is shown

userStories.title: Status explanation for new users
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to understand what SAFE, CAUTION, and RISKY mean the first time I see them, so that I can trust and act on the result.
acceptanceCriteria: First status result screen includes a brief one-sentence explanation of what the current status means (not a tutorial — inline, contextual)
Status is displayed with color + icon + text label from the very first result
A dismissible info tooltip is available on the status badge explaining the three-tier system

userStories.title: Pro paywall on 3rd card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to be prompted to upgrade when I try to add a 3rd card, so that I understand what Pro unlocks before committing.
acceptanceCriteria: Hard paywall screen appears when a Free user attempts to add card #3

Paywall shows: feature list (unlimited cards, payment planning, installment tracking, AI alerts), annual plan as primary CTA with '₱83/mo, billed ₱999/yr — Save 44%' badge, monthly plan as secondary option
Existing 2 free cards remain fully accessible and functional; the user is never locked out of already-added data

userStories.title: 14-day Pro trial
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to start a free 14-day Pro trial without being charged upfront, so that I can experience all Pro features before deciding to subscribe.
acceptanceCriteria: Trial CTA 'Try Free for 14 Days' is available on the card 3 paywall and the payoff planner entry point
RevenueCat handles trial mechanics; payment method is required at trial start but no charge occurs for 14 days
Trial end date is shown in the Pro settings screen: 'Your trial ends on [date]'

userStories.title: Pro upgrade after trial
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to upgrade to Pro after my trial ends, so that I can continue managing all my cards with full Pro features.
acceptanceCriteria: Paywall shows annual plan (₱999/yr) as primary pre-selected option; monthly plan (₱149/mo) shown below as secondary
Price framing includes 'Less than one late payment fee' and 'Cancel anytime' copy
RevenueCat entitlement 'pro' is granted immediately on purchase and verified on every app launch

userStories.title: Graceful Pro expiry
userStories.description: As Ria, I want my existing card data to remain visible (read-only) if my Pro trial expires before I upgrade, so that I don't lose information I've entered.
acceptanceCriteria: On Pro trial expiry: cards 3 and above become read-only — balance and status are visible but editing and reminders are disabled
A soft upgrade banner appears on read-only cards: 'Reactivate Pro to manage all cards'
Card data is preserved for 90 days post-expiry; a warning is shown before any data deletion occurs

userStories.title: Offline-first core features
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to use Falcly's core features without an internet connection, so that I can check my card status even when I have poor mobile data.
acceptanceCriteria: SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY calculation, Swipe Impact, best card recommendation, and Gantt timeline all function fully offline
Offline state is indicated by a small non-blocking 'Offline' chip in the header — it never blocks any core screen
Only cloud sync (Pro feature) requires connectivity; its unavailability is communicated without blocking the app

userStories.title: Secure local data storage
userStories.description: As Ria, I want my financial data stored securely on my device, so that my card balances and limits are not accessible to unauthorized parties.
acceptanceCriteria: Firestore offline persistence stores data encrypted at rest via the native Firebase SDK
Sensitive fields (balances, limits) are never logged or exposed in debug builds
Pro cloud sync encrypts card config client-side (AES-256-GCM) before transmission — Firestore stores ciphertext only; balances and transactions never leave the device unencrypted
userStories.notes: Updated from SQLite/SQLCipher to Firebase Firestore per tech stack decision

userStories.title: CSV export
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to export my card data as a CSV, so that I have a backup of my information independent of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV export is available from the settings screen and exports all cards, installments, subscriptions, and the user profile (income, payday, expenses)
Export works on both Free and Pro tiers
CSV format includes column headers and uses ₱ for currency values in PH locale

userStories.title: PostHog analytics
userStories.description: As a developer, I want behavioral events tracked anonymously via PostHog, so that I can understand which features drive retention and conversion.
acceptanceCriteria: Key events are tracked: card_added, swipe_check_performed (with status and amount tier), pro_conversion_started (with source), pro_trial_started, pro_converted (with plan type), data_staleness_warning_shown
No PII is tracked: no card numbers, no exact balances, no names — only behavioral events and anonymized tiers
PostHog is configured on EU region for RA 10173 / GDPR compatibility; analytics opt-out is available in settings

userStories.title: Crash reporting
userStories.description: As a developer, I want crash reports sent automatically, so that production issues are surfaced without requiring user reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Firebase Crashlytics is initialized on app start with source maps uploaded via EAS Build
beforeSend hook strips any PII from Crashlytics breadcrumbs before transmission
Crash reports are visible in Firebase console within 60 seconds of a crash occurring on a user device
userStories.notes: Updated from Sentry to Firebase Crashlytics per tech stack decision
